Mission
 At ING, we believe in giving people the freedom to grow, explore, and build what matters to them. Our Analytics capabilities stand at the heart of that mission -- powering decisions that shape products, protect customers, and help millions stay a step ahead in life and business. If you're passionate about turning data into actionable insights that drive business growth, you'll feel right at home here.
 About The Team
 You'll join a deeply analytical team within Retail Banking, focused on turning complex data into clear, actionable insights . The team partners closely with business stakeholders to uncover hidden patterns, support data-driven decision-making, and enable leaders to maximize impact. You will work closely with Analytics peers and the Pricing & Value Leads on in-depth and advanced analytics initiatives; the environment is collaborative, insight-driven, and geared toward delivering measurable business value through rigorous analysis and thoughtful interpretation.
 Your day-to-day
 In This Role, You Will
 As a Data Analyst in an Agile Way of Working, you will be a part of a Squad and will dedicate your time and efforts to achieve the tribe/ squad's purpose through:
Gather, prepare, and analyse large datasets to deliver robust insights supporting business strategies across customer, marketing, and digital channels.
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytical datasets tailored to business needs, ensuring accuracy and clarity in all outputs.
Collaborate with stakeholders and senior analysts to identify opportunities, design and execute segmentation, campaign analysis, and product evaluations.
Coach and mentor junior analysts, promoting best practices within the team.
Act as main point of contact for cross-functional projects, maintaining alignment on definitions, data structures, and objectives.
Conduct deep-dive analyses to identify business drivers, proactively recommending actions to enhance customer understanding and optimize campaigns.
Document dashboards, metrics, and models, performing regular quality checks to ensure data integrity.
Support development of advanced analytical frameworks in partnership with Data Scientists and Data Engineers.
Drive process optimization by ensuring reusability of scripts and methodologies and provide support across Customer Intelligence as needed.
 What You Bring To The Team
Education & Experience: University degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Marketing, Cybernetics, or a related field. Solid experience in data analysis, ideally in banking or financial services.
Technical Skills: Proficiency with data tools such as SAS, SQL, Python, and BI platforms (Power BI). Experience creating dashboards, campaign and product analyses, and data validation.
Analytical Mindset: Able to interpret complex data, spot trends, and generate actionable recommendations.
Collaboration & Communication: Strong communication skills; able to translate technical insights for non-technical audiences, building partnerships across teams.
Continuous Learning: Embraces new tools and methodologies.
Innovation: Seeks new ways to solve challenges and add value.
Personal Attributes: Ambitious, proactive, team-oriented, detail-focused, and adaptable.
 What We Offer
Impactful work in a fun, inclusive and highly collaborative environment.
Modern, open office spaces built for teamwork and creative work.
Hybrid working model with flexibility baked in.
Monthly benefit budget you can use your way.
Extra paid vacation days based on total work experience.
Continuous learning opportunities through ING Learning Centre, Udemy, Bookster, trainings and certifications.
Internal mobility across ING worldwide, including short- and long-term international assignments.
Opportunities to contribute to sustainability and CSR initiatives.
 Job Application Safety Reminder
 We're seeing an increase in fraudulent job offers. To protect yourself, please:
Apply only via official ING platforms. ING uses Workday as its recruitment system.
Verify the sender's email -- it should only come from @ing.com or @myworkday.com.
Know that ING will never request payments or banking details during the recruitment process. 
 How To Apply
 Click "Apply" on our careers site and submit your application through Workday.
We're excited to meet you!
 Discover ING Bank Romania
 ING believes in a world where everyone should have the freedom to grow in their own way -- our global tagline, "do your thing" , reflects this belief. We empower our people with autonomy and expect them to use it to create meaningful impact for customers, colleagues and the organization.
Working here means being surrounded by energetic, ambitious and supportive colleagues. We embrace curiosity, thrive on change and continuously explore better ways of doing things.
With more than 30 years of presence in Romania, ING has been a pioneer in transforming the local banking landscape, driven by technology and innovation.
ING Bank Romania is the only bank in the local top 10 that has achieved its position through organic growth , without acquiring portfolios or other banks. We serve over 2.0 million clients across Retail, SME & Mid-Corporate and Wholesale Banking.
